title: Traitprint Vault v1
description: Contract for the vault v1 file tree. Each $defs entry validates one file type; see README.md for layout and markdown-body conventions.
$comment: Contract revision 1.1 — adds optional experienceFrontmatter.skill_ids (additive; vaults written against 1.0 remain valid, schema_version stays 1). Revision 1.2 — adds optional experienceFrontmatter.skill_links (additive; vaults written against 1.0/1.1 remain valid). Revision 1.3 — adds optional profile basics.phone, basics.url and basics.profiles (additive; vaults written against 1.0-1.2 remain valid). Revision 1.4 — adds the optional top-level lenses.json array ($defs/lens): positioning lenses, an emphasis-only projection over the vault (canonical semantics in lens-v1); unique kebab-case slugs with 'none' reserved, at most one is_default, at most 20 lenses; also adds the add_lens/update_lens proposal kinds to $defs/proposal (the kinds shipped with 1.4; the enum here caught up in a later correction); additive, schema_version stays 1. Revision 1.5 — adds optional experienceFrontmatter.scope ($defs/experienceScope): quantified role scope (reporting line, headcount, budget/hiring/decision authority, platform scale, org context); all fields optional, only set fields are written (absent scope is omitted, never null/empty), attestation-ready — each field addressable as (experience_id, field_name); additive, vaults written against 1.0-1.4 remain valid, schema_version stays 1. Revision 1.6 — adds optional artifact_links on storyFrontmatter AND experienceFrontmatter ($defs/artifactLink): evidence URLs, provenance ladder rung 1 ('artifact-supported'); each entry is {url, label?} with url https-only and <= 500 chars, label optional <= 120 chars, at most 8 links per entity; only set fields are written (unset label is absent, never null) and an empty list never reaches frontmatter, so vaults written against 1.0-1.5 remain valid and round-trip byte-identically, schema_version stays 1. Revision history in README.md.

lensSlug.description: Revision 1.4: a lens slug — lowercase kebab-case, unique per vault. 'none' is reserved (the canonical-rendering keyword).

salience.description: Revision 1.4: per-skill emphasis within a lens. core = foregrounded/boosted, supporting = default, suppressed = hidden from the rendered profile and excluded from the lensed skill set.

skillLink.description: Revision 1.2: a per-skill proficiency annotation on an experience. skill_ids stays authoritative for membership; an entry whose skill_id is not in the experience's skill_ids carries no membership effect.

scopeText.description: Revision 1.5: a short-text scope fact (card-sized, not narrative).

experienceScope.description: Revision 1.5: the optional scope block of an experience — quantified role scope for recruiter-grade calibration. Every field is optional and only set fields are written (an absent scope is omitted entirely, never serialized as null or an empty object, so pre-1.5 vaults round-trip byte-identically). Attestation-ready: each field is addressable as (experience_id, field_name) so future single-field attestations can attach without a schema migration.

reporting_line.description: Who the role reported to, e.g. 'VP of Data'.

platform_scale.description: Short text, e.g. '2,500+ dbt models, 30-person data org'.

org_context.description: Company stage/size/scale context, e.g. 'public co, ~7k employees'.

artifactLink.description: Revision 1.6: one artifact_links[] entry on a story or experience — an evidence URL (provenance ladder rung 1, 'artifact-supported'): a public artifact evidencing the parent entity (repo, PR, talk, press, published work). url is https-only; an unset label is omitted, never null. At most 8 entries per entity; an empty list is never written.

url.description: https-only evidence URL (plain http and every other scheme are rejected).

label.description: Optional short display label, e.g. 'conference talk' or 'launch post'.

profileLink.description: Revision 1.3: one basics.profiles[] entry — a JSON Resume profile item (social/professional link).

profile.description: profile.json — JSON Resume-compatible keys where they overlap.

location.description: Plain string (deviation from JSON Resume's location object).

url.description: Revision 1.3: personal website/portfolio URL (omitted while empty).

skill.description: One element of the skills.json array.

education.description: One element of the education.json array.

experienceFrontmatter.description: YAML frontmatter of experiences/*.md; the markdown body is the role description.

storyFrontmatter.description: YAML frontmatter of stories/*.md; the body carries '## Situation/Task/Action/Result' (+ optional '## Lesson') sections.

philosophyFrontmatter.description: YAML frontmatter of philosophies/*.md; the body is the stance in the user's own words.

proposal.description: proposals/*.json — a staged write awaiting review. Never applied until approved.

kind.description: Revision 1.4: add_lens/update_lens shipped with the positioning-lens feature (this enum caught up in a later correction; the reference validation lives in traitprint.proposals / the hosted vault_propose).

target_id.description: Required for update_* kinds: the id of the entity being changed.

payload.description: Entity fields (full entity for add_*, changed fields for update_*). For markdown-backed entities the narrative text travels in payload.body.

rationale.description: Why the proposer believes this change is right; shown at review time.

lens.description: Revision 1.4: one element of the lenses.json array — a positioning lens (emphasis-only projection over the vault; canonical semantics in lens-v1). Signature/salience references are Layer 1 (dangling refs are surfaced live, never a parse error). Vault-level invariants — unique slugs, at most one is_default, at most 20 lenses — are enforced by the reader/ingest, not expressible per-object here.

headline_override.description: Optional; must not assert a fact absent from the vault (trust layer).

bio_override.description: Optional; must not assert a fact absent from the vault (trust layer).

skill_salience.description: Map of skill UUID → salience. Unspecified skills default to 'supporting'.
